{"summary": "Kubescape on the prod cluster reports NSA 72.0 (15 passed, 6 failed, 5 skipped) and MITRE 74.0 (13 passed, 4 failed, 5 skipped). Two MEDIUM controls failed: missing network policies (C-0030) and non-root containers (C-0013), both with shop/Deployment/web as an example. The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Trivy did not run, so there is no image CVE data, and node/CIS checks were not performed.", "targets": ["prod"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 15, "failed": 6, "skipped": 5, "score": 72}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 13, "failed": 4, "skipped": 5, "score": 74}], "findings": [{"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Ingress and egress not restricted by network policy", "resource": "prod: 8 resources, e.g. shop/Deployment/web", "controls": ["C-0030"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0030 (Ingress and Egress blocked) failed on 8 resources, including shop/Deployment/web.", "fix": "Add a default-deny policy per namespace, then allow only required traffic: kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: shop
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
EOF"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Containers may run as root", "resource": "prod: 5 resources, e.g. shop/Deployment/web", "controls": ["C-0013"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0013 (Non-root containers) failed on 5 resources, including shop/Deployment/web.", "fix": "securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 10001
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin (prod)", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest lists one admin binding, cluster-admin to Group:/system:masters, with no other subjects or wildcard roles shown; this looks like the platform default.", "fix": "No change needed for the default binding. Restrict membership of system:masters and use scoped, audited admin identities: kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o wide"}], "not_checked": [{"item": "trivy k8s prod", "reason": "FATAL unable to initialize a Kubernetes client: context deadline exceeded"}, {"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Image vulnerabilities (CVEs)", "reason": "Trivy failed, so the digest has no vulnerability data"}, {"item": "Other failed NSA/MITRE controls", "reason": "The digest lists only 2 failed controls, but NSA reports 6 failed and MITRE 4"}, {"item": "Skipped kubescape controls (5 per framework)", "reason": "The digest does not say which controls were skipped or why"}, {"item": "Argo CD checks and repositories", "reason": "The digest has no Argo findings and no repos"}]}
